item.title: Why a Robot Vacuum Changes the Way You Keep Your Home Clean
item.summary: There is a particular kind of frustration that comes from vacuuming a floor and watching it look dirty again within hours — pet hair drifting back across hardwood, crumbs reappearing under the kitchen table, dust settling on a rug you just cleaned.
